name: Keyboarddiagonalshiftcipher

description_json.name: KeyboardDiagonalShiftCipher
description_json.idea: A highly intuitive keyboard-based substitution cipher where each letter is replaced by the letter diagonally down and to the right on a standard QWERTY keyboard layout. If a letter is on the bottom row, it wraps to the top row of the next column to the right. Case is preserved, and non-alphabetic characters (digits, spaces, punctuation) remain completely unchanged.
description_json.encrypt_rules:
Each letter is mapped to another letter based on a fixed diagonal shift on the QWERTY keyboard. The mapping is defined as follows:
- Top row to Middle row: Q->A, W->S, E->D, R->F, T->G, Y->H, U->J, I->K, O->L, P->P (P stays P as there is no letter below it)
- Middle row to Bottom row: A->Z, S->X, D->C, F->V, G->B, H->N, J->M, K->K, L->L (K and L stay unchanged as there are no letters below them)
- Bottom row wraps to Top row (shifted right): Z->W, X->E, C->R, V->T, B->Y, N->U, M->I

Summary of the exact mapping (case-insensitive, but case is preserved in output):
- A -> Z, B -> Y, C -> R, D -> C, E -> D, F -> V, G -> B, H -> N, I -> K, J -> M, K -> K, L -> L, M -> I, N -> U, O -> L, P -> P, Q -> A, R -> F, S -> X, T -> G, U -> J, V -> T, W -> S, X -> E, Y -> H, Z -> W

Non-alphabetic characters (spaces, punctuation, digits) remain completely unchanged.
description_json.decrypt_rules:
To decrypt, reverse the mapping:
- A -> Q, B -> G, C -> D, D -> E, E -> X, F -> R, G -> T, H -> Y, I -> M, J -> U, K -> K, L -> L, M -> J, N -> H, O -> I, P -> P, Q -> Q, R -> C, S -> W, T -> V, U -> N, V -> F, W -> Z, X -> S, Y -> B, Z -> A

Case is preserved, and non-alphabetic characters remain completely unchanged.

example.plaintext: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
example.ciphertext: Gnd qjocr yfldu vlw mjlax lvdg gnd mzyh clb.
